scripts.v2:gen: go tool buf generate && go tool buf generate --template buf.gen.thirdparty.yaml
scripts.v2:up: docker compose -f deploy/compose/compose.yaml --env-file deploy/compose/dev.vars --profile core up -d --build --wait
scripts.v2:up:full: docker compose -f deploy/compose/compose.yaml --env-file deploy/compose/dev.vars --env-file deploy/compose/full.vars --profile core --profile full up -d --build --wait
scripts.v2:down: docker compose -f deploy/compose/compose.yaml --env-file deploy/compose/dev.vars --profile core --profile full down
scripts.v2:lint: go tool golangci-lint run ./... && go tool buf lint
